title: lathyrus albus
intro: Lathyrus albus, commonly known as the white pea or white vetchling, is a species of flowering plant in the pea family (Fabaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to act as a natural anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, which may help to protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Lathyrus albus include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. Additionally, the plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues.
